content:
[Intro]
[B5]
[E5]
I'm alone,

[Verse 1]
[E5]
sitting with my empty glass.
My four
walls
follow me through my
past.
I was on a Paris train
I emerged in Lon
don rain And
you were waiting there
Swimming through apologies.

[Chorus]
[A5]I remember
[B5]searching for the
[G5]perfect words.
[D5]
[A5]I was hoping you
[B5]might change your mind.
[G5]
[A5]I remember a
[B5]soldier sleeping
[G5]next to me.
[D5]
[A5]Riding on the me
[G5][B5]tro. [A5]
[B5]

[Pre-Verse]
[E5]
You wore white.

[Verse 2]
[E5]
Smiling as you took my hand.
So removed,
we
spoke of wintertime in
France.
Minutes passed with shallow words.
Years have passed and still
the hurt.
I can see you now,
smiling as you pulled away.

[Chorus]
[A5]I remember the
[B5]letter wrinkled
[G5]in my hand.
[D5]
[A5]"I'll love you al
[B5]ways" filled my eyes.
[G5]
[A5]I remember a
[B5]night we walked a-
[G5]long the Seine.
[D5]
[A5]Riding on the me-
[B5]tro. [G5][A5]
[B5]

[Solo]
[E5]

[Chorus]
[A5]I remember a
[B5]feeling coming
[G5]over me!
[D5]
[A5]The soldier turned,
[B5]then
[G5]looked away.
[A5]I remember
[B5]hating you for
[G5]loving me!
[D5]
[A5]Riding on the me-
[B5]tro. [G5][A5]
[B5]

[E5]
I'm alone,

Swimming through apologies.
